parsed.why: No trans-specific offence; embedded third-gender tradition, judicial recognition, pride and education give documented acceptance. But recent street harassment of visibly trans people, implementation gaps and rising political hate speech keep it below protection-working tier.

Buggery statute with 10-year sentence on the books; police harassment of trans women; mob killing of gender-nonconforming teen unsolved; impunity, prison targeting, no gender-recognition framework for custody; overwhelming social hostility.

Gender-identity anti-discrimination and hate-crime provisions in force, police acting on lethal hate speech, legal aid and care services operating. Negatives are dated LGBTQ-wide surveys and political hate speech, not traveller-facing restrictions.

Private conduct not prosecuted and reported violence punished, but police extort men perceived as gay using an ambiguous 'acts against nature' article; no discrimination or hate-crime protection; 73% of capital residents hostile.

State-directed targeting: police register of LGBTIQ people, fake-meeting entrapment, extortion, raids with forced HIV testing and arbitrary charges, ill-treatment in custody; no SOGI protection; society and religious authority entirely hostile.
